description: This file defines the ProjectController class, which extends an abstract Vue controller to manage project-related views and permissions within the orangehrmTimePlugin module. It handles pre-render setup such as creating Vue components, fetching unselectable project IDs via a service, and setting permissions.

classes.name: ProjectController
classes.description: Controller managing project views and permissions in the time module.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component with unselectable project IDs and sets permissions before rendering.
